docTitle: Mamta Singh Sengar — Agelix QA Test Lead
name: MAMTA SINGH SENGAR
title: ==QA TEST LEAD==  ·  TEST PLANNING & TEAM EXECUTION

sections.heading: SUMMARY
sections.body: QA professional with **4.8 years of experience**, including **leading QA teams and managing test planning** as Senior QA at Chetu. Led test planning and execution for web/mobile modules, coordinated scrum ceremonies, and **mentored junior testers (onboarded 4)**. Oversaw test case design, regression execution, and defect management end-to-end.

sections.heading: CORE SKILLS
rows: ==Test planning== · ==Team coordination== · ==Mentoring (4 testers onboarded)== · ==Test execution oversight==
Functional · Regression · Sanity · Smoke · Integration · UAT
Jira · Local Test Case Generator (Jira workflow)
sections.note: LEADERSHIP GAP — your title is Senior QA, not QA Test Lead. This role expects formal team leadership; your mentoring (4 testers) and scrum coordination are the evidence. Be ready to describe how you assigned work, tracked team progress, and reviewed others' test cases. If a past manager can verify, add a reference line.

roles.title: Software Test Engineer / Senior QA
bullets: ==Led QA teams== — coordinated scrum ceremonies, conducted demo calls, and mentored junior testers (onboarded 4).
==Managed test planning== and oversaw execution of test cases for web/mobile modules; authored 500+ test cases.
==Led test strategy== — implemented UI automation and CI/CD integration, cutting release verification time from 3 days → 1 day.
Conducted demo calls to stakeholders; increased early defect detection by 25%.

roles.title: Testing Engineer
bullets: Executed functional, integration, system, regression, and UAT cycles for payment, gaming, and retail domains.
Tracked defects in Jira and improved defect resolution SLA from 72 hrs → 48 hrs.
Validated payment transactions and MPOS flows; analysed middleware logs to reduce payment failures by 20%.

roles.title: Career Break & Upskilling
bullets: Playwright: built automated web test suites; converted 100 manual scenarios to automated checks.
CI/CD: integrated test execution into Jenkins and GitHub Actions for PR gating and nightly regression.
Local Test Case Generator (Jira): designed a workflow to auto-generate structured test cases from Jira tickets, reducing test design time by 50%.
AI Prompting for QA: created prompts/workflows to generate test ideas and edge cases, accelerating test design by 40%.
